name: Freelancer Duck Collection
description: Spawns ducks on the supplier desk.

options.name: Spawn The In-flu-ential Duck
options.tooltip: A rubber duck dressed in an evening gown. When this proximity-activated device detects motion nearby, it emits a cloud of emetic gas, inflicting immediate nausea and sickness on those caught in it.

options.name: Spawn The Poker Face Duck
options.tooltip: A rubber duck with a legendary poker face. Remote activated, when triggered, it plays sounds of a casino payout, attracting those nearby.

options.name: Spawn The Tracksuit Duck
options.tooltip: A rubber duck that resembles an old friend. When this proximity-activated device detects motion nearby, it detonates a concussive explosive.

options.name: Spawn The Trophy Duck
options.tooltip: Make this gilded geometric flash device part of your winning strategy by "presenting" it to your enemies. Can they handle the fame? The glory? The flashing lights? Hopefully not.

options.name: Spawn The Chainsaw Duck
options.tooltip: "How is this duck holding a chainsaw? It doesn't even have hands!" That will be the last thought running through your target's head before they're blown to bits.

options.name: Spawn The Proximity Explosive Duck
options.tooltip: A medium explosive device designed to resemble a rubber duck. Detonated by proximity. Exercise caution when placing. Will attract casual attention if spotted.

options.name: Spawn The Remote Explosive Rubber Duck Mk II
options.tooltip: A medium explosive device designed to resemble a rubber duck. Detonated remotely. Exercise caution when placing. Will attract casual attention if spotted. It also has the signature Mk II look.

options.name: Spawn The Sunset Rubber Duck
options.tooltip: An exclusive rubber duck painted in a gorgeous gradient.

options.name: Spawn The Creator Duck
options.tooltip: Being a creator is a kind of superpower. So is a good explosive. This duck will ensure that your target meets their maker. Now that's what we call great content.

options.name: Spawn The IOI Showcase Duck
options.tooltip: Slick suit. Blank stare. And just enough boom to clear a room. Classic IOI charm.

options.name: Spawn The Dino Duck
options.tooltip: Righten up any location with this cute little green duck! But handle with care – if activated, it's sure to give an explosive performance that no one will forget.

options.name: Spawn The Dragon Duck
options.tooltip: A medium explosive rubber duck device designed to resemble a dragon. Breathes fire before remotely detonating. Place carefully to tip the scales in your favor. Will attract casual attention if spotted.

options.name: Spawn The Neon Duck
options.tooltip: Always trending, always deadly. One cute dance, one wrong tap, and boom—you're part of the algorithm now.

options.name: Spawn The Purple Streak Explosive Duck
options.tooltip: Everyone's favorite remote rubber explosive device is back! Now in purple. This is a sure fire hit to gain the attention of any target. But place with caution: this cute little thing is deadly.

options.name: Spawn The Muay Thai Duck
options.tooltip: A rubber duck dressed for a close-quarters fight. When this proximity-activated device detects motion nearby, it detonates a concussive explosive..

options.name: Spawn The Banger Duck
options.tooltip: A rubber duck ready to light up the club. A proximity-activated explosive. When dropped, it plays an irresistibly catchy tune that will draw anyone's attention.

options.name: Spawn The Vuvuzela Duck
options.tooltip: When the remote is squeezed, it emits a famously loud buzzing noise. Press said remote to detonate the duck and cause an EVEN LOUDER noise.

options.name: Spawn The Bowtie Duck
options.tooltip: A rubber duck with a charming disposition. When an enthralled target picks it up, they'll become easily traceable in any crowd.

options.name: Spawn The High Performance Duck
options.tooltip: A remote-activated explosive device designed to optimize your combat experience. Painted with a fetching go-faster stripe – and just look at those reflections!

options.name: Spawn The See-No-Evil Duck
options.tooltip: A rubber duck with an eyepatch. When this proximity-activated device detects motion nearby, it emits a flash of light that briefly blinds enemies.

options.name: Spawn The Dank Duck
options.tooltip: A relaxed-looking rubber duck. When this proximity-activated device detects motion nearby, it emits a cloud of sedative gas, putting the target into a deep sleep.

options.name: Spawn The Proximity Explosive Rubber Duck Mk II
options.tooltip: A medium explosive device designed to resemble a rubber duck. Detonated by proximity. Exercise caution when placing. Will attract casual attention if spotted. It also has the signature Mk II look.

options.name: Spawn The Hijacker Duck
options.tooltip: Contrary to popular belief, size doesn't always matter. Though this duck may be small enough to avoid perception, when remotely activated, it emits a powerful EMP charge.

options.name: Spawn The Remote Explosive Duck
options.tooltip: A medium explosive device designed to resemble a rubber duck. Detonated remotely. Exercise caution when placing. Will attract casual attention if spotted.
